name: Occasional One-Sided Getback
definition: The **Occasional One-Sided Getback** parameter is the favorable-sequence mistake bound when feedback may be withheld, and every feedback signal that is given only reports that the learner made a mistake; the signals remain consistent with a target concept in $\mathcal H$.
graph_summary: Favorable-sequence mistake bound with optional, mistake-only feedback.
origin_references: The learner-chosen presentation and one-sided occasional-feedback model are discussed in \cite{ben1997online}.

monotonic.proof: Any favorable-sequence, one-sided-feedback strategy valid for every target in $\mathcal H$ is still valid after restricting the set of possible targets to a subfamily.
